data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google Places API using native SDKs on mobile and REST on web/desktop.
data.what_it_does: Provides access to the Google Places API (New) across Android, iOS, Web, and desktop platforms. It handles autocomplete predictions, place details, text search, nearby search, and place photos using native SDKs on mobile devices.
use_when: You need Google Places search, autocomplete, and details in a Flutter app.
You want to use native Google Places SDKs on Android and iOS for API key security.
You require cross-platform support including Web, Linux, macOS, and Windows.
avoid_when: You need platform-agnostic HTTP-only requests where native SDK integration is not desired.
You require specific Place fields that are not supported on certain platforms (such as iOS).
strengths: Full Google Places API (New) coverage with ~45 fields and 30+ place types.
Uses native Android and iOS SDKs for better application-restricted API security.
Supports all platforms: Android, iOS, Web, Linux, macOS, and Windows.
weaknesses: Not all Place fields are supported on every platform due to native SDK differences.
Location restriction is not supported on the web platform.
data.setup_notes: Requires a Google Cloud API key and enabling the Maps JavaScript API if targeting the web.
